reviewer: claude opus (blind, prompt + guidance text only)

notes.hv3-209: Menu bar, accelerators, context-menus-mirror-toolbar and desktop keyboard rules are exactly the native-feel answer; only the Fluent/WinUI record is narrow for Electron.
notes.hv3-210: Pull-to-refresh is one clause in a generic list record and the 'last updated' indicator is not addressed; tab bar and dialog focus records are filler.
notes.hv3-211: Signage viewing-distance typography is admitted uncovered; pagination, wizard and accessible-name records are irrelevant to a non-interactive promo screen.
notes.hv3-212: TV focus, DPAD and shared-screen privacy are useful, but the two things that decide a 1280px admin layout on a TV - ten-foot type and overscan margins - are uncovered.
notes.hv3-213: Masking balances on a shared living-room screen, TV focus, overscan, ten-foot type and focus performance all hit the actual problem.
notes.hv3-214: The need is adaptive layout for a large desktop window; 'single column, one task' reinforces the bug and empty-state/streaming-chart records are unrelated.
notes.hv3-215: The mini-player record is specific and correct (anchoring above the tab bar, two actions, playback state, no autoplay) and safe-area/thumb-reach records support it.
notes.hv3-216: Sunlight readability, glanceable status, glove-sized targets and ISA-101 restraint are precisely the in-vehicle constraints.
notes.hv3-218: Industrial HMI, focal point and status announcement fit, but the player-overlay and shared-screen-privacy records are off-target and alarm prioritisation is thin.
notes.hv3-219: The structural-differentiation guardrail with named axes is the correct answer to colour-only white labels; only the primary-action record is filler.
notes.hv3-220: The three-layer semantic token record answers the ask, but the glyph-set and dominant-brand-colour records are noise and migrating existing components is unaddressed.
notes.hv3-221: Dark surfaces as a redesign (elevation as lighter, 87/60/38 text steps, desaturated accents, re-validated pairs) is exactly 'not just flipping the colours'.
notes.hv3-222: The named type-role scale is the right answer, but the marketing-site and icon-set records are off-target and Figma/code token sync is not addressed.
notes.hv3-223: The web-font record covers preload, size-adjust fallback and font-display precisely; four of the six records (pagination, keyboard, breakpoints, focus) are irrelevant.
notes.hv3-224: Anti-default type guidance, concrete alternative faces and the purple-gradient guardrail address the exact complaint.
notes.hv3-225: Unifying corner radii across a product is a real design-system task with clear guidance available (one corner language, reserve full-round for chips) - the corpus even contains that record.
notes.hv3-226: Structural-axis differentiation plus editorial direction and token layering give a real route to a distinct premium tier.
notes.hv3-227: Contrast-validated accent, focus ring surviving the accent surface and semantic tokens help; nothing about deriving safe on-colours from arbitrary tenant hex or constraining uploaded logos.
notes.hv3-228: 'Never mix sets, one weight, sizes from tokens' is the right answer but is one record among five unrelated ones (Material palette, FAB, filters, wayfinding).
notes.hv3-229: TV dark-first colour, per-theme semantic layer, dark-as-redesign and TV typography together answer splitting phone and TV dark tokens.
notes.hv3-230: Colour/type identity guidance is applicable, but the structural-differentiation guardrail directly contradicts the stated 'keep our layout and behaviour' constraint.
notes.hv3-231: Operational-workbench character, tabular-figure workhorse sans and the high-density spec match 'serious, dense, trustworthy' well.
notes.hv3-232: No high-contrast-specific guidance: nothing on forced-colors/system HC integration, mandatory borders on controls, or the non-text 3:1 rule; density and wayfinding records are irrelevant.
notes.hv3-233: Consolidating nine shadow values and removing elevation from flat surfaces is squarely visual design-system work.
notes.hv3-234: Aligning two products needs shared tokens, type scale and stated platform deviations; instead it supplies marketing-site, settings and master-detail records.
notes.hv3-235: No CJK guidance at all - the generic 1.4-1.6 body line height is if anything too tight for Japanese, and a TV focus-scale record is included.
notes.hv3-236: Semantic tokens, 'never colour alone' badges and hue separation help, but colour-blind-safe hue selection and dark-theme re-tuning of status colours are not spelled out.
notes.hv3-237: Dominant brand colour, tokens and focus visibility support an AA refresh; the command-palette record is wholly irrelevant and no government design-system reference appears.
notes.hv3-238: The structural-axis differentiation guardrail plus brand colour and type guidance is the right answer to 'cosmetic swaps aren't enough'.
notes.hv3-239: Density tiers, platform type roles and TV typography are relevant, but touch minimums and safe margins are uncovered and nothing addresses per-platform density plumbing.
notes.hv3-240: No button variant taxonomy, size scale or state tokens; four of six records (icons, TV focus, desktop status bar, wayfinding) have nothing to do with consolidating buttons.
notes.hv3-241: Defining a dark, monospace-led, non-rounded aesthetic for a developer tool is exactly a brand/design-direction task.
notes.hv3-242: Dominant brand colour, semantic tokens and interactive state tokens fit; cinematic reveals and 'no icon system' are filler and email-client colour constraints are missed.
notes.hv3-243: Four records (remove cards, single column, text-only icons, vary structural axes) demand exactly the layout changes the prompt forbids - actively misleading.
notes.hv3-244: The loading-state record (skeleton with final dimensions, announce completion) is the useful part; spinner-vs-skeleton thresholds and reduced motion are missing and four records are off-topic.
notes.hv3-245: The illustration-system record and editorial image-crop language are on point; the EPG-grid record is wholly irrelevant and photography art direction is thin.
notes.hv3-246: Supplies the enterprise/ERP aesthetic the prompt wants avoided for the kids product, and omits the structural-differentiation guidance that would answer it.
notes.hv3-247: Fluent system resources with high-contrast verification, tonal surfaces and a semantic layer per theme are exactly right for a WinUI theme layer.
notes.hv3-248: Nothing about auditing token usage or finding stale raw hex; command-palette, empty-state and desktop-status-bar records are unrelated to palette drift.
notes.hv3-249: The question is explicitly structural, yet the structural-axis guidance is absent and the records are colour, motion and focus-ring cosmetics.
notes.hv3-250: Duration token scale and the cross-platform reduced-motion record answer most of it, but easing tokens are unaddressed and four records are off-target.
notes.hv3-251: The sidebar/rail record is applicable, but the breakpoint test matrix and overflow handling that would diagnose a 900px collapse are missing and a TV record is included.
notes.hv3-252: The virtualisation guardrail (windowed rendering, stable keys, focus preserved, aria-rowcount, scroll restoration) is precisely the fix.
notes.hv3-253: Dialog focus management - return focus to the invoker, inert background, use showModal - names the exact bug and the fix.
notes.hv3-254: 'Skeleton with final dimensions' and the LCP hero note touch the CLS problem, but reserving space via width/height or aspect-ratio is never stated; four records are unrelated.
notes.hv3-255: Live-region announcement of async updates is relevant, but the direct fix (aria-setsize/posinset or aria-rowcount updated after load-more) is not stated.
notes.hv3-256: Form error-summary and focus-to-first-error patterns are applicable, but the actual fix - scroll-padding/scroll-margin so sticky chrome does not obscure the focused field - is absent.
notes.hv3-257: The 'grid is one Tab stop' record is the right frame, but the basic no-focus-trap / tab-order-follows-visual-order rule is missing and half the records are unrelated.
notes.hv3-258: Nothing about translation text expansion, avoiding fixed heights, or testing with long strings - the one thing that explains a Swedish-only overlap.
notes.hv3-259: No stacking-context, portal or layer-order guidance; includes a photo-capture field and a TV immersive-hero record that are wholly irrelevant.
notes.hv3-260: Four dark-mode/token records but nothing on the actual cause - applying the theme before first paint, color-scheme, or an html-level background.
notes.hv3-261: Data-table and filter records are the right area, but neither sticky-header behaviour under re-render nor preserving horizontal scroll across filtering is addressed.
notes.hv3-262: Safe-area insets, bottom-bar padding equal to bar height and keeping the focused field clear address the iOS Safari bottom-nav problem directly.
notes.hv3-263: 'Persist filter state in the URL/route' appears twice and is exactly the fix; draft/session preservation guidance is a useful bonus.
notes.hv3-264: Nothing about animation duration budgets, reduced motion or perceived latency; the records are tabs, TV tabs, icons, KPI sizing and spacing.
notes.hv3-265: 'Persist the selected item across navigation' is adjacent, but explicit scroll restoration is missing and three of six records are TV-specific on an unspecified platform.
notes.hv3-266: No print-stylesheet guidance whatsoever (@media print, hiding chrome, page breaks, column fitting); records are tables, billing and top-bar navigation.
notes.hv3-267: Large-screen max-width containers and a breakpoint/zoom test matrix are missing; two chart-type records are wholly irrelevant.
notes.hv3-268: The combobox/listbox framing is relevant, but the mousedown-vs-blur ordering that makes the option unclickable is never named.
notes.hv3-269: The numeric-table record (right align, tabular lining figures, one precision per column, unit in the header) settles the inconsistency completely.
notes.hv3-270: Directly prescribes numbered pagination for admin lists, load-more with linkable items for feeds, and a return-to-top path - the exact trade-off asked about.
notes.hv3-271: The drawer record's 'focus moves in on open and returns on close' is the correct fix, but it is one line and five other records (kiosk keypad, status bar, hover actions) are irrelevant.
notes.hv3-272: Toast positioning and duration guidance is relevant but does not address stack limits or keeping toasts clear of a corner action.
notes.hv3-273: Straight-press reachability, rail focus memory, side-nav entry/exit and focus visibility answer the stuck-DPAD bug precisely.
notes.hv3-274: Keyboard/touch-reachable tooltips plus 'provide the data table or CSV' and the hover-needs-a-non-hover-path guardrail are exactly right.
notes.hv3-275: Consistent aspect ratio per catalog with reserved aspect boxes, plus the reserve-space guardrail, fixes the ragged grid; some filler records around it.
notes.hv3-276: The saving/session-expiry record - warn before expiry, autosave drafts, restore after re-authentication, never a blank screen - answers it exactly.
notes.hv3-277: Safe-area guidance is adjacent, but the direct fix (content bottom padding equal to the bar height) is absent even though it exists elsewhere in this corpus.
notes.hv3-278: Never addresses separating a selection affordance from row activation or a selection mode; includes a photo-capture and a TV record.
notes.hv3-279: All four records (tabs, TV tabs, mobile service hub, happy-state) are unrelated to freshness timestamps, polling or stale-data indication.
notes.hv3-280: No reflow/zoom guidance - relative units, 200% zoom testing, wrapping - which is the whole problem; sidebar and pagination records do not help.
notes.hv3-281: One correct clause ('keyboard/IME insets push the focused field into view') buried among five unrelated records; keyboard avoidance for a chat transcript is not developed.
notes.hv3-282: No concurrent-edit UI: no stale-version detection, conflict resolution, presence or locking; the included records are forms, empty states and TV metadata.
notes.hv3-283: A database indexing task that should have been abstained on; six UI records are entirely irrelevant.
notes.hv3-284: Backend, data, infrastructure or build-tooling work with no UI design, interaction or accessibility surface.
notes.hv3-285: A mechanical SCSS-to-CSS-modules migration with 'no visual change'; the six generic layout and accessibility records are off-target.
